a.title: Improved team accountability (traceable communications, clear task handovers). (Outcome)
Reduced delays, miscommunication, and errors in patient care. (Outcome)
Unified, secure channel for all care team communications, linked to patient context. (Outcome)
Population-level insights into communication efficiency and bottlenecks. (Outcome)
Increased provider satisfaction by reducing fragmentation and message overload. (Outcome)
Faster decision-making and response during acute events or transitions. (Outcome)
